title: Conditional Pleiades excess-column distance from member reddening and Gaia DR3

sources.title: Lindegren et al. parallax zero point
Gibson and Nordsieck 2003 II scattering geometry

measurements.selection: Catalogue members, RUWE < 1.4, parallax S/N > 50, no duplicate or non-single-star solution, image multi-peak fraction <= 2%, valid zero-point correction; published reddening caveats excluded.
measurements.distanceMethod: 1000 / (parallax - zero point), using high-S/N geometric parallaxes rather than GSP-Phot fitted distances.

fit.quantity: Additional-column transition, not either separately resolved scattering sheet
fit.model: d = d0 + a*x + b*y; three regional coverage probabilities and a Gaussian transition convolved with stellar distance errors
fit.coordinates: x east, y north, pc projected at 134.84134308 pc; ICRS origin RA 56.67978318 deg, Dec +24.10845447 deg
fit.labels: E(B-V) >= 0.07 additional reddening; <= 0.05 lightly reddened; two ambiguous retained stars omitted
fit.priors: Uniform 115 < d0 < 155 pc, -5 < a,b < 5 pc/pc, regional coverage in [0,1]; fixed 1% label error
fit.uncertaintyMeaning: Conditional on plane, labels, priors, thin transition and adopted errors; not a complete spatial astrometric covariance or photometric-systematics posterior.
fit.systematics: Coherent +/-0.02 mas offset shifts the fitted center by about +/-0.37 pc. Cool-star reddening systematics and label choices materially broaden or shift the fit.

notMeasured: Secure tilt, curvature, physical thickness or two sheets separated by 0.35-0.7 pc.
Precise individual B-star depths: several bright stars have poor Gaia solutions or no parallax.
A universal cloud edge or full column: low-column patches can remain lightly reddened behind the transition.

adoptedRealization.meaning: Conditional registration and stellar plane, not new measurements. Native profile shapes remain; map widths include smoothing and posterior uncertainty.

localEvidence.limitation: Original tables, queries, fit drivers and plots remain local research evidence. The published prepared display can be restored without them.
